name: retried_ack_replays_the_original_acknowledgement
review: Enabled owner-only and exact-epoch ACK retry rows preserve the original timestamp and whole item without consulting the clock, including after expiry; wrong owner and wrong epoch remain refused. Concurrent ACK and generation-isolation rows are adjacent named regressions.
limitation: Work-store ACK semantics only; Run result independence and platform facets remain separately pending. Stop replay is covered by the distinct B248 subset. This source binding is not an execution witness.

name: retried_stop_after_lost_response_replays
review: Enabled owner-only and exact-epoch stop retry matrix on Volatile, independent file SQLite handles and live PostgreSQL pools: retain original timestamps/subject after releasing the lease, revoke the digest, never restore authority, reject foreign identities and later generations. Adjacent named regressions cover concurrent stops, durable reopen/new pool, committed PostgreSQL reply with an actual late-reload mutant, and both published migration histories without inventing historical stop owners.
limitation: Work-store completion receipts only. A retained exact proof is not a newly authenticated Session bearer; stopped bearers remain revoked. Managed Environment-credential retry preserves the original projection; this is not hosted-service or process-crash qualification. Original E17 failure remains retained under its original source. No full T08-C02 acceptance is inferred.

name: work_and_dispatch_epochs_are_distinct_types
review: Controlled SessionWorkerLeaseAuthority acquisition returns a kernel-backed SessionWorkGrant with WorkLeaseEpoch. Neutral SessionWorkLease transfer DTOs and WorkSessionAccess retain their compatible numeric/kernel representation. Compile the actual acquisition consumer against DispatchSettlement, alongside a valid Dispatch consumer and the unchanged neutral DTO consumer.
limitation: Only the controlled Session operation boundary prevents implicit Work-to-Dispatch generation substitution; an explicit numeric projection remains possible. The type-name assertion alone is not compiler evidence. E17 keeps its original source/log identity; complete lifecycle/platform acceptance remains pending.

name: owner_only_reclaim_preserves_the_credential_principal_boundary
review: The compatibility role authenticates a credential principal, not a physical process incarnation. A reclaimed current principal succeeds; foreign principals fail without mutation; stop replay restores no authority. The original impossible same-principal/absent-generation oracle is retained under E17, not relabelled as a pass.
limitation: This row does not fence an old process presenting the same credential. Stronger incarnation guarantees require client/credential participation; Session Work can use the exact-generation role. No full T09-C02 acceptance is inferred.
